sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: one book, one pen, one child and one teacher can change the world.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈbʊk, ˈwʌn ˈpen, ˈwʌn ˈtʃaɪld ænd ˈwʌn ˈtiːtʃə kæn ˈtʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈwɜːld./
sentences.meaning: 一个书，一个笔，一个孩子和一个老师可以改变世界。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Teachers open the door, but you must enter by yourself.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtiːtʃəz ˈəʊpən ðə ˈdɔː, ˌbʌt juː ˈmʌst ˈentə baɪ jɔːˈself./
sentences.meaning: 老师打开门 但你必须自己进来

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Tell me and I forget, teach me and I may remember, involve me and I learn.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtel ˌmiː ænd ˌaɪ fəˈget, ˈtiːtʃ ˌmiː ænd ˌaɪ ˈmeɪ rɪˈmembə, ɪˈnvɒlv ˌmiː ænd ˌaɪ ˈlɜːn./
sentences.meaning: 告诉我，我忘了， 教我，我可能记得， 参与我和学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈbjuːtɪfʊl ˈθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈlɜːnɪŋ ɪz ðæt ˈnəʊ ˈwʌn kæn ˈteɪk ɪt əˈweɪ frɒm juː./
sentences.meaning: 学习的美丽之处在于没有人能夺走它

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are many famous quotes and sayings about learning.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeə ɑː ˈmeniː ˈfeɪməs ˈkwəʊts ænd ˈseɪɪŋz əˈbaʊt ˈlɜːnɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 关于学习，有许多著名的引言和说法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Find more and discuss them with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪnd ˈmɔː ænd dɪˈskʌs ˌðem wɪð jɔː ˈklɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 找更多的东西和同学们讨论一下
